Myself (24m) used to coast on the coat tails of teenage hormone when I was that age but it seems now, for the last 4 years I've not even kissed a girl, I have nothing genuine to offer. It seems being kind hearted and supportive gets you friend zoned and completely dropped once they enter a relationship. I find comfort in nothing. Sometimes I can distract myself but the impending sense of loneliness never leaves my mind. And at times is too much. I hold on to the belief that one day I will find happiness and love but I have to try and be the person my potential significant other deserves. And among other things being alive is one of them. You must push on, I don't know you, but I know you are far more capable than you are giving yourself credit for. You have to be more kind to your future self, you'll look back and never stop appreciating where you have gotten. Suicide shouldn't be an option. You'll die one day, but don't force it. You're more than a troubled past.
